newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-VALENCIA APPOINT FORMER REAL MADRID COACH VALDANO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VALENCIA APPOINT FORMER REAL MADRID COACH VALDANO.

text.p: Valencia have appointed former Real Madrid coach Jorge Valdano to take over from Luis Aragones, fueling speculation that World Cup striker Romario may return to the club.
Valdano is known to admire the Brazilian, who returned to Flamengo on loan earlier this month after repeatedly clashing with Aragones.

Valdano, himself a World Cup winner with Argentina in 1986, took Real to the Spanish league title in 1995, but lost his way last season and was given his marching orders at the halfway stage of the championship.
An exponent of open, attacking play, Valdano is also known as an eloquent commentator and columnist.
